template: Is joint {axis} at the same position at {t1}ms and {t2}ms (tolerance of {eps_1} rad)? Answer only with 'Yes' or 'No'.
What is the status of the position of joint {axis} between {t1}ms and {t2}ms (tolerance of {eps_1} rad)? Answer only with the letter of the correct option.
What is the absolute difference in position of joint {axis} between {t1}ms and {t2}ms in rad? Answer only with a numerical value.
Has the friction proxy for joint {axis} increased from {t1}ms to {t2}ms (tolerance of {eps_2}%)? Assessed using a symmetric half-window of {delta_1}ms. Answer only with 'Yes' or 'No'.
How did the friction proxy for joint {axis} change from {t1}ms to {t2}ms? Answer only with the letter of the correct option.
What is the ratio of the friction proxy at {t2}ms compared to {t1}ms for joint {axis}? Answer only with a numerical value.
Is the end-effector acceleration magnitude at {t_ms}ms greater than {accel_threshold} m/s^2? Answer only with 'Yes' or 'No'.
Which axis (X, Y, or Z) of the end-effector has the highest absolute acceleration at {t_ms}ms? Answer only with the letter of the correct option.
What is the acceleration of the end effector at {t_ms}ms? Answer only with a tensor of length 3 (X, Y, Z in m/s^2), separated by '_'.
Is an external force detected at {t_ms}ms (threshold of {eps_3} N)? Answer only with 'Yes' or 'No'.
What is the detected state of external forces at {t_ms}ms? Answer only with the letter of the correct option.
What is the magnitude of the external force detected at {t_ms}ms in N? Answer only with a numerical value.
Does the jerk of joint {axis} at {t_ms}ms exceed {jerk_threshold} rad/s^3? Answer only with 'Yes' or 'No'.
What is the magnitude range of the jerk for joint {axis} at {t_ms}ms? Answer only with the letter of the correct option.
What is the jerk of joint {axis} at {t_ms}ms in rad/s^3? Answer only with a numerical value.
Is the torque magnitude about the {axis_label}-axis at {t_ms}ms greater than {torque_threshold} Nm? Answer only with 'Yes' or 'No'.
Compare the torque magnitude about the {axis_label}-axis at {t_ms}ms to a threshold of {torque_threshold} Nm. Answer only with the letter of the correct option.
What is the torque magnitude about the {axis_label}-axis at {t_ms}ms in Nm? Answer only with a numerical value.
